responsibility: This file implements conditional control-flow expansion from trees and RTL comparisons into branch instructions. It owns deferred stack-pop bookkeeping used around call arguments, conversion of boolean and comparison expressions into compare-and-jump sequences, multiword and floating-point comparison splitting, target-aware bit-test and compare strategy choices, and helpers that emit direct RTL jumps or fallthrough control flow with branch probability information during expression and statement expansion.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file in the `dojump` group: it contains the actual compare-and-branch expansion, split-comparison handling, bit-test preference logic, and pending-stack-adjust execution, while `gcc/dojump.h` just declares those jump-expansion and stack-adjustment interfaces.
